newsitem.title: THAILAND: Dynamic Eastern has non-performing loans.
newsitem.headline: Dynamic Eastern has non-performing loans.

text.p: Dynamic Eastern Finance Thailand said on Wednesday that it had 2.217.4 billion baht in non-performing loans but stressed it was not facing a liquidity crunch as reported in the local media.
The company said in a filing to the stock exchange that it was stepping up eforts to urge debtors to repay their debts.
Of the total non-performing loans, Dynamic Eastern said debts from finance loans amounted to 1.652 billion baht ($66.0 million). Of the total, 89.82 percent or 1.484 billion baht were secured loans.
Debts from margin loans amounted to 565.7 million baht with 24.7 percent or 139.7 million baht in secured loans, it added.
The company said it had set up four new departments responsible for urging debtors to repay and to sell securities against bad loans.
The company said it had requested the Bank of Thailand to extend the deadline for it to increase its capital by 500 million baht to 180 from 60 days set by the central bank earlier.
It said it was awaiting a reply from the central bank.

On March 3, the Bank of Thailand ordered 10 financial firms, including Dynamic Eastern, to increase their capital immediately because they did not have sufficient provisions for doubtful loans and sub-standard assets and they faced short-term cashflow problems.
